title: The Friendship That Needed a Calendar
title_ja: 予定表が必要だった友情
fact_notes: 登場人物・出来事は架空の教材例。実在の調査結果ではない。リンクは制作台帳であり実証資料ではない。

sentences.en: Nora and Lily became friends while working at a summer camp.
sentences.ja: ノラとリリーは夏のキャンプで働いている間に友達になった。

sentences.en: After the camp ended, they moved to different cities for college.
sentences.ja: キャンプ後、大学進学のため別々の都市に移った。

sentences.en: At first, they exchanged messages almost every evening.
sentences.ja: 最初はほぼ毎晩メッセージを交換した。

sentences.en: However, their college schedules gradually became more demanding.
sentences.ja: しかし大学の予定は徐々に忙しくなった。

sentences.en: One week, Lily sent Nora a message about an important examination.
sentences.ja: ある週、リリーは重要な試験についてノラにメッセージを送った。

sentences.en: Nora read it while traveling but forgot to reply later.
sentences.ja: ノラは移動中に読んだが後で返信するのを忘れた。

sentences.en: Lily became worried because she had expected an answer that evening.
sentences.ja: リリーはその晩に返信を期待していたため心配になった。

sentences.en: She wondered whether Nora was no longer interested in their friendship.
sentences.ja: ノラがもう友情に関心を持っていないのではと考えた。

sentences.en: A few days later, Nora called Lily and explained what had happened.
sentences.ja: 数日後ノラはリリーに電話して事情を説明した。

sentences.en: She apologized for forgetting the message but also described her busy schedule.
sentences.ja: メッセージを忘れたことを謝り、忙しい予定についても説明した。

sentences.en: Together, they discussed what kind of communication would suit both of them.
sentences.ja: 二人ともに合った連絡方法について話し合った。

sentences.en: Neither wanted their friendship to become another source of pressure.
sentences.ja: どちらも友情が新たな重圧になることを望まなかった。

sentences.en: They decided to arrange a short video call on alternate Sundays.
sentences.ja: 隔週の日曜日に短いビデオ通話を設定することにした。

sentences.en: If either person was busy, they would suggest another suitable time.
sentences.ja: どちらかが忙しいときは別の都合の良い時刻を提案することにした。

sentences.en: They continued sharing photographs and messages without expecting immediate replies.
sentences.ja: すぐに返信を求めず、写真やメッセージを共有し続けた。

sentences.en: The new arrangement helped them enjoy conversations with fewer misunderstandings.
sentences.ja: 新しい取り決めによって誤解が減り、会話を楽しめるようになった。

sentences.en: Lily realized that frequent messages were not the only sign of friendship.
sentences.ja: リリーは頻繁なメッセージだけが友情の証ではないと気づいた。

sentences.en: Nora learned that an explanation could prevent unnecessary worry.
sentences.ja: ノラは説明が不必要な心配を防げると学んだ。

sentences.en: Both friends valued the relationship enough to adjust their habits.
sentences.ja: 二人は習慣を調整するほど互いの関係を大切にした。

sentences.en: Their friendship changed its rhythm without losing its meaning.
sentences.ja: 友情はその意味を失わずにリズムを変えた。

vocabulary.definition: an organized activity where people stay or work together
not one and not the other
a feeling of being under strain

questions.prompt: Where did Nora and Lily become friends?
options: At college in the same city.

questions.prompt: What began to demand more of their time?
Why did Nora fail to reply?
options: She read the message while traveling and forgot.
She could not read Lily's language.
questions.explanation_ja: 移動中に読んで返信を忘れた。

options: Nora might no longer value their friendship.
Nora had already taken the examination.
Nora was moving into her city.
Nora wanted to work at camp again.
questions.explanation_ja: 友情への関心を失ったと心配した。

questions.prompt: What did Nora explain during the call?
options: A plan to end their friendship.
The price of a new phone.
What happened and how busy her schedule was.
questions.explanation_ja: 返信できなかった事情と予定。

questions.prompt: What does pressure mean in context?
When did they plan video calls?
How did their expectations about messages change?
options: They agreed never to send messages.
They no longer expected an immediate reply.
They expected answers within one minute.
questions.explanation_ja: 即時の返信を求めなくなった。

questions.prompt: What did Nora learn could prevent worry?
questions.explanation_ja: 説明によって心配を防げる。

options: Friends can maintain a relationship by adapting how they communicate.
Real friends must communicate every day.
Any missed message means a friendship is ending.
questions.explanation_ja: 連絡の方法を調整して友情を維持できる。

grammar.focus: while working at a summer camp
grammar.explanation_ja: while＋動名詞相当の分詞節は同時の状況を表す。

grammar.focus: whether Nora was no longer interested

grammar.explanation_ja: neitherは二人のどちらも〜ない。

discourse.role_ja: 頻繁な連絡と多忙な状況を対比。
謝罪だけでなく事情説明も行った。

paraphrases.source: Nora and Lily became friends while working at a summer camp.
paraphrases.rewrite: They met and became friends during their work at a summer camp.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: キャンプで働いて友達になった。

paraphrases.source: She wondered whether Nora was no longer interested in their friendship.
paraphrases.rewrite: She wondered if Nora had lost interest in being friends.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 友情への関心を失ったかと考えた。

paraphrases.source: Neither wanted their friendship to become another source of pressure.
paraphrases.rewrite: Both of them wanted to avoid making the friendship stressful.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 二人とも友情が負担になるのを避けたかった。

paraphrases.source: If either person was busy, they would suggest another suitable time.
paraphrases.rewrite: When one of them was unavailable, they would propose a different time.
paraphrases.explanation_ja: 都合が悪ければ別の時刻を提案する。

cloze.explanation_ja: その晩に返信を期待した。
すぐの返信を求めない。
